notes: No new stories created to avoid duplication. Existing stories refined for completeness and clarity.

Clarified conditional execution and fallback behavior when travel API fails or location is missing.

stories.title: Define Clinical Trials Search Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define request and response schema for clinical trials search including condition, location, recruiting status, eligibility summary, structured trial metadata, and optional travel metrics.

stories.title: Implement ClinicalTrials.gov Search Logic
stories.description: Implement ClinicalTrials.gov API integration with recruiting filter, condition/location query handling, structured parsing of trial data, eligibility summary normalization, trial site extraction, pagination handling, error handling, and rate-limit resilience.

stories.title: Add Travel Distance and Time Enrichment
stories.description: Add optional travel distance and duration enrichment using Google Routes API based on user location and trial sites, with conditional execution, graceful fallback when location is missing, and failure handling when the external API is unavailable.

stories.title: Expose Clinical Trials Search via Evaluate Care Facade
stories.description: Expose clinical trials search via EvaluateCare facade and tool router with validated inputs, strict schema enforcement, structured output, and compatibility with chat tool-use patterns per GOV-004.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Clinical Trials Search
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests covering API fetch, parsing, eligibility normalization, travel enrichment, facade-level response validation, and edge cases including empty results, malformed responses, timeouts, and external API failures.
